<function name="Register" parent="scripted_ents" type="libraryfunc">
	<file line="53-L139">lua/includes/modules/scripted_ents.lua</file>
	<description>
Registers an ENT table with a classname. Reregistering an existing classname will automatically update the functions of all existing entities of that class.

<bug pull="1300">Sub-tables provided in the first argument will not carry over their metatable, and will receive a BaseClass key if the table was merged with the base's. Userdata references, which includes Vectors, Angles, Entities, etc. will not be copied.</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ENT" type="table">
			The ENT table to register.  
			For the table's format and available options see the <page>Structures/ENT</page> page.
		</arg>
		<arg name="classname" type="string">The classname to register.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<code>
local ENT = scripted_ents.Get( "gmod_button" )
local oldUse = ENT.Use

function ENT:Use( activator, caller, type, value )
	print( tostring( self.Entity ) .. " just got pressed!" )
	oldUse( self, activator, caller, type, value )
end

scripted_ents.Register( ENT, "gmod_button" )
	</code>
</example>
